policy.unconditionalRow: probMax > 0, has groups, no encounter event gate, every referenced group is resolved, and every referenced group has appearByItemId == -1 and notAppearByItemId == -1
policy.mixedRow: contains at least one unconditional group plus one or more item-gated groups; retained as candidate but not advertised as fully unconditional
policy.unresolvedRow: any referenced group missing from fixed group1.txt; never promoted
policy.runtimePath: This index is source-coordinate evidence only. Exact path-to-region closure still requires the matching LS2MAP runtime.
